task_description: Discovering high-performance, low-iridium bimetallic oxide catalysts for the acidic oxygen evolution reaction (OER) by optimizing surface Ir composition, chemical ordering, and oxygen vacancy concentration in rutile-type TiO2-based systems to maximize Ir mass-specific activity and minimize overpotential.

datasets.db_title: DFT-calculated OER overpotential dataset for 66 binary oxide combinations
datasets.db_description: A custom computational dataset containing density functional theory (DFT)-calculated theoretical OER overpotentials for 66 dopant-support combinations (11 guest elements doped into 6 rutile-type oxide supports: IrO2, MoO2, TiO2, MnO2, PdO2, SnO2), used to screen and identify Ir-doped TiO2 as the most promising low-Ir candidate. The dataset includes overpotential values for both dopant-site and host-metal-site activity, enabling comparative ranking of catalytic performance across the compositional space.

datasets.db_title: Bayesian-optimized DFT dataset for IrTiO2 configurations
datasets.db_description: A dataset of 139 DFT-calculated ΔGO − ΔGOH values generated through 8 iterations of Gaussian process–based Bayesian optimization on IrTiO2 surface models (4×2 (110) slabs with 192 atoms), covering varied Ir surface ratios (12.5%–87.5%), chemical orderings, and coordination environments. This dataset trains the surrogate machine learning model to predict adsorption free energy differences and guide the search toward configurations maximizing Ir mass-specific activity.

datasets.db_title: Oxygen vacancy–augmented DFT dataset for IrTiO2−x
datasets.db_description: A custom computational dataset comprising ~285 DFT-calculated ΔGO − ΔGOH values for IrTiO2−x structures, generated by systematically removing 1–4 oxygen atoms from subsurface layers of pre-optimized IrTiO2 configurations. It includes distributions of adsorption energetics for Ti and Ir sites with/without vacancies and is used to train a machine learning model that predicts how oxygen vacancies modulate Ti-site activation and overall mass activity.

datasets.db_title: Material Project database (rutile oxide unit cells)
datasets.db_description: The Materials Project database was used to download initial crystallographic structures (P42/mnm space group) of rutile-type oxides (e.g., TiO2, IrO2), which were then re-optimized via DFT. These experimentally validated, thermodynamically stable bulk structures served as the foundational input geometries for constructing all surface slab models (2×1 and 4×2 (110)) used in the DFT screening and optimization workflow.
